During the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]], a group of [[Disciples of Ragnos]] saboteurs '''infiltrated''' a power plant on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. A team was sent to investigate by Bakuran authorities, but the infiltrators killed the team. Jedi trainee [[Jaden Korr]] then [[Mission to Bakura (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|arrived]] and defeated the invaders.
